column6: Hero, mightiest of the @wDN{Anuna} gods, who comes forth from the @wTN{E-kur}! @wDN{Ninurta}, Lord @wDN{Nunamnir} created you like a great storm ……, he commanded you to achieve triumphs for him.

For you @wDN{Nintur} has opened wide her creative hands; she has breast-fed you from her sweet breasts; she has fed you with the milk of vigour. As if you were a spectacular wild bull, she has made your figure strong, she has made your limbs massive. She has fitted you out with …… appearance, awesome radiance and heroism. Your mother, @wDN{Nintur}, held you by the right wrist as she led you before your father in @wTN{E-kur}, the august shrine. Then she said: @q[Nintur,Enlil]{“Decide a great fate for the son who is your avenger!”}

@wDN{Enlil} looked at him with joy and decided his fate: @q[Enlil,Ninurta]{“@wDN{Uta-ulu}, may your name be exalted throughout the extent of heaven and earth. Your awesome radiance will make all the great gods tremble with fear.”}

@q{“Your roaring and commands make all the foreign countries submit. Your frightening look makes all enemies tremble! @wDN{Uta-ulu}, when like all the evil winds you rise to …… like @wDN{Gibil}, the lord of ……, the hero; @gap{1 line unclear} After you have completely devastated the rebellious lands, ……, all the great gods will duly praise your supremacy!”} …… your father decided your destiny.
……, make …… hostile to him bow down for @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}}, the son of @wDN{Enlil}!

@gap{3 lines unclear} You have counted …… as ruin-mounds, to be mixed with dust. You have swept over ……, you obliterated it. @wDN{Ninurta}, hero of @wDN{Enlil}, as you are sitting on your throne-dais, may your spouse, the true lady @wDN{Ninnibru}, who embraces you, step before you daily with friendly words on behalf of @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}}! @wDN{Uta-ulu}, may you be his aid when he prays! May he be able to rely on your words, may he be peerless! May he be the king whose fate @wDN{Ninurta} decides, the one endowed with attractiveness! @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}}, the prince who is a supporter of yours, the son of @wDN{Enlil}, has established justice in @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad}, and made the Land feel content.
May the shepherd, the expert, most wise in leading, guide the people for you!
Great hero, when for prince @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} you reduce to heaps the rebellious lands which are insubordinate to him, may ……!

Lord, mighty flood which tears out the roots of the enemy! @wDN{Ninurta}, mighty flood which tears out the roots of the enemy, may you put a weapon into the mighty hands of prince @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} which will snap his enemies in two as if they were reeds!
